lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments are visible across the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively uniform in the midsection, with slightly higher density/narrower spacing observed at the posterior flank near the haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the second line from the posterior, splitting near the ventral margin. A minor Y-shaped junction is visible on the third posterior line at approximately mid-torso height.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The most anterior line segments near the shoulder are truncated, terminating mid-torso. The first and second posterior lines transition into discrete spots near the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch, positioned below the primary vertical line terminations and above the hind limb joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots on the posterior haunch align to form a semi-connected diagonal geometric line angled at approximately 45 degrees towards the tail base.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns emerge from the skull at a 45-degree posterior angle, exhibiting a lyrate curvature that bends outward and then inward towards the midline.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 1.8 times the combined pixel width of the two horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping is visible on the terminal 20% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a singular high-contrast white spot on the malar region (cheek) and a distinct white chevron-shaped marking between the eyes.
